description: This file defines the interface and class declaration for LifecycleManagerImplementation, which implements lifecycle management, state management, configuration, and event handling for applications within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data members related to application lifecycle operations.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements application lifecycle, state, configuration, and event handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. Manages notifications, application contexts, and dispatches lifecycle events.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class representing a dispatchable job that handles lifecycle events asynchronously, maintaining references to the parent implementation and event data.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification interface for lifecycle management.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification interface for lifecycle management.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently loaded applications, optionally verbose.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific application is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Starts a new application instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Sets the desired lifecycle state for an application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Sends an intent to the currently active application.

methods.name: StateChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicates completion of a state change for an application.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Closes an application with a specified reason.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the lifecycle manager with the provided service.
